title: Z → ee in one prompt on the ATLAS AF
subtitle: One prompt to Claude Code (Sonnet). Under four minutes later there is a tutorial notebook on the UChicago AF that finds an ATLAS Run 3 sample, streams it from the facility cache and fits the Z peak.

setup.intro: atlas-af is one MCP endpoint in front of the facility's services: ATLAS knowledge search, AMI, Rucio, JupyterHub, HTCondor and more. You log in with your AF account; the gateway acts with your own credentials, so Claude never holds them.

steps.label: Add the server to Claude Code
steps.code: claude mcp add --transport http atlas-af https://mcp.af.uchicago.edu/mcp/

steps.label: Log in
steps.note: Inside Claude Code, pick atlas-af and authenticate with your AF account.

steps.label: Or run it headless with a token
steps.note: This is how this replay was recorded: af-mcp.json points at the same endpoint with an Authorization: Bearer header holding a personal access token. The allowlist permits the atlas-af tools, reading the AF docs site, and the date command.

chapters.title: Find a copy at the facility

cards.title: No dataset name, no package list
cards.body: The prompt names the physics goal and the facility's quirks (empty Rucio tags, a missing XRootD client, an IPv4-only cache), not the answer. Claude has to discover the sample, the data location and the software itself.

cards.title: Tools load on demand
cards.body: The gateway exposes many tools. Claude loads only the schemas it needs, in small batches, as the task moves from one service to the next.

cards.title: A usage baseline
cards.body: af_usage reports your own calls and an estimate of the tokens their results put into Claude's context. Calling it before and after gives the cost of this run.

cards.title: A notebook server in 11 seconds
cards.body: jhub_create_jupyter_server starts a JupyterHub server in your name on the facility's ML image. While it spawns, Claude already queries AMI and the knowledge base in parallel.

cards.title: AMI picks the sample
cards.body: ami_list_datasets lists the Run 3 PHYSLITE Z→ee samples. Claude picks the inclusive Powheg sample, DSID 601189, and later gets its cross-section from AMI: 1998.8 pb.

cards.title: A selection to cite
cards.body: aos_search in the analysis scope returns ATLAS analysis notes, so the notebook's electron cuts come with a documented source.

cards.title: The notebook exists
cards.body: jhub_nb_* tools edit and run notebook cells on the server. Every step from here is a saved cell, so the student gets the outputs, not just the code.

cards.title: Mistakes are cheap
cards.body: The first cross-section call used the wrong argument name. The gateway returns the tool's real schema with the error, and the retry a second later succeeds.

cards.title: Rucio decides where to read
cards.body: Most tags AMI lists have no files in Rucio. Claude checks the newest p-tag's containers for a replica at the facility's own storage (MWT2), running the queries in parallel, and finds the one that has it.

cards.title: Reading the facility docs
cards.body: Two quick fetches of the AF documentation give the XCache URL form and the pixi recipe for adding packages to the notebook image.

cards.title: Installing XRootD in 6 seconds
cards.body: pixi add, lock and install run in one cell with PIXI_CACHE_DIR on local disk. The default cache sits in the NFS home directory, where pixi hangs.

cards.title: Fix and re-run
cards.body: One line of the import check failed. Claude edits that cell and re-runs it, so the saved notebook is clean.

cards.title: Streaming through the facility cache
cards.body: uproot opens the file through the UChicago XCache, with XRD_NETWORKSTACK=IPv4 so the connection doesn't stall, and reads only the first 10,000 events.

cards.title: The physics
cards.body: Two opposite-charge good electrons per event give 3,725 pairs; 3,640 fall in 60–120 GeV. The median m_ee is 90.6 GeV.

cards.title: Checking a figure by numbers
cards.body: The prompt tells Claude it can't see the plot, so it places the ATLAS label above the axes and then checks the geometry in code: every label's bottom edge sits above the top of the axes.

cards.title: What it cost
cards.body: The second af_usage call closes the books: 45 gateway calls and about 17,000 estimated tokens of tool results, with 100 s of gateway time in a 3 min 22 s run.

cards.title: The deliverable
cards.body: A link to the finished notebook, a results table (Gaussian fit μ = 91.01 ± 0.08 GeV), and a candid note on where the MCP helped and where it got in the way.

outro.note: Recorded on 2026-11-15 (US Central) by running the demo prompt headless with Claude Sonnet and the atlas-af MCP server. Internal addresses are masked. The notebook server was deleted after the recording.
